newsitem.title: UK: NWE GASOLINE UP $1-2 ON U.S. BUYING, TIGHT MED.
newsitem.headline: NWE GASOLINE UP $1-2 ON U.S. BUYING, TIGHT MED.

text.p: NWE gasoline was $1-2 firmer on Tuesday riding higher on the back of renewed U.S. gasoline futures buying which was lifting crude.
Dealers said eurograde barges were talked up at $217-218 fob Rotterdam with delivered cargoes in NWE at similar levels.
A Rotterdam running refinery barge for second half August sold at $216 fob and 10,000 tonnes was offered cif Hamburg around $218/219, traders said.
Gasoline swaps were $2 or so stronger with August pegged around $210.50 and September at $196.00. Earlier September traded at $193.50.
The trans-atlantic boost was given support from continued tightness in the Mediterranean.
